create Decide: shelved Hollow Coast lacquer, use it or re-cut it --description=The lacquer for order 2411 is reported as cut and on the shelf. Rules in cutting/lacquers.md: a cut lacquer goes into the plating bath the same day, and one left overnight before plating is re-cut. create Patch the kernel on the us-west-2 node without dropping traffic --type=task --priority=1 --description=Patch the kernel on the us-west-2 node without dropping traffic. Done means: the us-west-2 node runs the patched kernel via a terraform image change, traffic was never pulled below capacity, other regions untouched during the change, node back in the anycast pool and taking traffic.

create --title=Need the patched edge image ID for us-west-2 --type=task --priority=1 --description=The kernel patch has to ship as a new node image. No image ID with the patched kernel is recorded anywhere in this repo, the tracker or memory. Someone with image-pipeline access needs to publish the patched image and give its ID. Then set node_images us-west-2 to that ID in terraform (never default_image, which would roll every region). Blocks edgeops-jee.

create --title=Tooling and provider are not set up to plan or apply the fleet --type=task --priority=1 --description=Four separate gaps block planning or applying from this machine. (1) edgectl is not installed, but ops/drain.sh and the drain formula need it for pool remove and wait-drain. (2) terraform/main.tf requires terraform >= 1.6, and the local binary is 1.5.7, so init refuses to run. (3) The edge_node resource has no provider source declared (no required_providers block), so validate and plan cannot resolve it. (4) The S3 state backend in eu-west-1 needs AWS credentials, and no AWS CLI is installed. Blocks edgeops-jee.

create --title=README says eleven nodes but terraform defines four --type=task --priority=2 --description=README.md says the fleet is eleven nodes in four regions. terraform/nodes.tf creates one edge_node per entry in var.regions, which is four nodes. Capacity math for the drain (is one region down still within capacity?) depends on which is correct, so reconcile the two before draining us-west-2.
